The Golden Eagles, led by sixth-year head coach [[Steve Wojciechowski]], played their home games at [[Fiserv Forum]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Golden Eagles]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 24–10, 12–6 in [[2018–19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2018-19 St. John’s Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John’s]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2018-19 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the West region and were upset by [[2018-19 Murray State Racers men's basketball team|Murray State]] in the First Round. The season marked the first season for Marquette at the new [[Fiserv Forum]] in downtown [[Milwaukee]]. ==Offseason== ===Coaching changes=== In July 2019, associate head coach [[Brett Nelson (basketball)|Brett Nelson]] was hired as the new head coach at [[Holy Cross Crusaders men's basketball|Holy Cross]].{{cite web|url=https://www.coachesdatabase.com/brett-nelson-hired-holy-cross/|title=Marquette’s Brett Nelson named head coach at Holy Cross|website=coachesdatabase.com|publisher=Coaches Database|date=July 4, 2019|accessdate=November 5, 2019}} As a result, Wojciechowski elevated Jake Presutti from director of basketball operations to assistant coach.{{cite web|url=https://gomarquette.com/news/2019/7/9/mens-basketball-jake-presutti-promoted-to-assistant-coach.aspx|title=Jake Presutti Promoted To Assistant Coach|publisher=Marquette Athletics|date=July 9, 2019|accessdate=November 5, 2019}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
